# Subham Travelers

> Direct chauffeur-driven cab operator and outstation taxi service based in Silk City, Berhampur (Ganjam), Odisha. Provides fixed-fare intercity transportation, Bhubaneswar Airport (BBI) transfers, local railway station pickups, and curated Odisha tourism circuits.

Subham Travelers operates 24x7 with verified commercial AC vehicles across all 30 districts of Odisha. Booking and instant quotation coordination is managed directly via telephone (+91 63712 58522) and WhatsApp.

## Core Services & Pages
- [Home Page](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/): Main booking desk, live corridor fare estimates, customer guarantees, and fleet overview.
- [Fleet Directory](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/fleet): Commercial AC vehicles including Sedan Dzire (4+1), Ertiga MPV (6+1), Innova Crysta (7+1), and Tempo Traveller (12-26 seats).
- [Curated Destinations & Circuits](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/destinations): Day tours and multi-day packages to Tara Tarini, Gopalpur-on-Sea, Tampara Lake, Taptapani Hot Springs, Jirang Tibetan Monastery, Daringbadi, Puri, and Chilika.
- [Popular Highway Routes](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/routes): Distance, driving duration, and vehicle pricing for Berhampur to Bhubaneswar Airport, Puri, Cuttack, Vizag, and Rayagada.
- [Direct Contact & Dispatch Desk](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/contact): 24x7 phone hotline (+91 63712 58522), WhatsApp dispatch desk, and Silk City office coordinates.
- [About Subham Travelers](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/about): Company background, commercial fleet standards, chauffeur verification, and Silk City dispatch history.
- [Customer Feedback](https://berhampurcab.vercel.app/feedback): Traveler reviews, ratings, and customer testimonial submission.

## Service Specifications
- Primary Operating Hub: Berhampur (Brahmapur), Ganjam District, Odisha 760001, India.
- Geographic Coordinates: Latitude 19.3149, Longitude 84.7941.
- Operating Hours: 24 Hours / 7 Days a week (24x7).
- Fare Model: Transparent fixed highway quotes with zero hidden driver night charges or platform surge pricing.
- Dispatch Phone: +91 63712 58522
- Booking Mode: Web application form, instant telephone dispatch, and WhatsApp hotline.
